title: Pad Light Choreographer
user: A MIDI-pad owner who wants hardware-first beat practice or tiny performances, with pad lights giving the next cue instead of a mouse-driven screen.
smallest_useful_product: Web MIDI PWA that discovers common grid pads, plays four-lane call-and-response patterns, lights target pads, and exports/imports compact JSON routines.
success_measure: 60% of supported-device visitors complete the connection test and play a first cue routine within five minutes; at least 30% save a routine.
constraints: Use only documented Web MIDI messages, test device mappings conservatively, and make unsupported hardware harmless; no copyrighted song content.
